secrets.title: Operation Daybreak: OZ or Independence Army
secrets.text: Two-way choice at the end of the stage: “Join OZ and work to restore order” enters the OZ route (next stage “A New Path”); “We cannot accept what OZ has done” enters the Independence Army route (next stage “Farewell, Warrior”)

secrets.title: Lera branch: Those Eyes Reflect No Future
secrets.text: At the start (Real only), pick “Say hello to Lera”: if you picked one of the first two options in Ideals, Shattered you go straight into the Lera branch; if you picked “Ignore her” you are asked again, and you enter it only if Ark picks “I was wrong last time” or Selain picks “That’s true, but...”. Picking “Leave her be” skips it. The Lera branch affects all three routes: on the Independence Army route you play “Those Eyes Reflect No Future” after “Mars and Marg” and can recruit Ehrlich; on the Complete Pacifism route Lera leaves in “Purification”; on the OZ route Lera dies in “Humanity's Victory, and Then... (Part 2)”

secrets.title: Four
secrets.text: Persuade Four with Kamille (requires both steps in “Hong Kong City of Sorrow” and “From Between Sea and Land”). Levels are compared right after the persuade: if Kamille's current level ≥ Jerid's, Four joins at the end of the stage; otherwise Four is destroyed and lost for good. Jerid's level = the average of the 15 highest-level pilots assigned to units on your team when entering this stage (rounded down, max 95) + 3
